summary: Valneva SE filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 4, 2026 press release announcing the date of its nine-month 2026 consolidated financial results and a related investor webcast. The release states results will be reported on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, with a live webcast at 3 p.m. CET / 9 a.m. ET, archived afterward. It also contains standard corporate boilerplate on the specialty vaccine business and forward-looking statements. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine earnings-timing notice rather than a special situation, offering no deal or risk-arb angle.
